description: Pins the instance_id rejections and the GET. instance_id is an integer path param, so both languages reject a missing or non-positive value with the same text, and both read a whole float as the resource it names.

cases.name: rejects a non-positive instance_id
cases.expect_error: instance_id must be a positive integer

cases.name: rejects an environment that is not a name
cases.expect_error: environment not found in configuration: true

cases.name: rejects an environment the config does not name
cases.expect_error: environment not found in configuration: staging

cases.name: refuses an argument the message does not declare
